title: Manifest Loader Helpers
intent: Add TypeScript manifest types and loader helpers for creating Excalibur sprites and animations from manifests.
acceptance: manifestTypes.ts exports CharacterManifest and TilesetManifest TypeScript types.
AssetManifestLoader.ts exports loadCharacterManifest, createAnimation, loadTilesetManifest, createTileSprite functions.
Loader works with Excalibur ImageSource, SpriteSheet, and Sprite.
outOfScope: Updating actor/scene code to use the loader.
